subject: httpuv and on the wire compression

messages.author: c8fe4075ec631c03
messages.subject: httpuv and on the wire compression
parts:
I haven't checked this, but it seems to me that moving 10,000 rows of a dataframe in json format across an uncompressed websocket might present certain performance problems.

Since the data is (presumaly) highly compressible (factors as strings comes to mind) I wonder if httpuv provides opportunities for transfer of bulk data over zlib compressed http?

-Alex

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: httpuv and on the wire compression
parts: Yes, that's definitely one possibility. Websocket compression is just starting to appear in Webkit so there is hope on that front as well; that's the way I'd prefer to do it, assuming browsers can get there in a reasonable timeframe.
